title: Salas rebuts the EMP explanation

tellings.quote: Bob Salas responded to this claim, quote unquote, it would have been irresponsible and unthinkable for the U.S. Air Force to jeopardize the operational status of these weapons.

related.note: Salas's rebuttal disputes the WSJ claim that an EMP test caused the 1967 Malmstrom shutdowns; it is a competing account of the same event.

plain: The Wall Street Journal offered an explanation for the 1967 events at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana: an electromagnetic pulse, or EMP, a burst of energy that can knock out electronics. A man named Robert Salas rejected it. Michels relays his answer, quoting Salas as saying that "it would have been irresponsible and unthinkable for the U.S. Air Force to jeopardize the operational status of these weapons". If Salas is right, the EMP account can't explain what happened to the weapons at the base.
